. The only "Terminated" status in that table is on the DCR-MYC row, which is run by Dicerna Pharmaceuticals, not NBF-006.

In Table 1[1], NBF-006 (GSTP target, LNP carrier, non-small cell lung cancer) is listed with status [2] and company [3]. The only "Terminated" status in that table is on the DCR-MYC row, which is run by Dicerna Pharmaceuticals, not NBF-006. [4] The text's termination discussion (efficacy and toxicity issues) concerns DCR-MYC, whose development was officially terminated in September 2016[5] for lack of MYC knockdown efficacy and a renal toxicity case. NBF-006 is mentioned in the text only as a member of a group of lipid-based siRNA drugs listed together with DCR-MYC.
